text.en:
Amendments to EO No. 53. (a) Section 1 is hereby amended to
read as follows:
"Section 1. Creation of the Boracay Inter-agency Task
Force. The Boracay Inter-agency Task Force ("Task Force") is hereby
created, to be composed of the following:
The Task Force shall be deemed dissolved on 08 May 2021,
unless extended or sooner terminated by the President."
(b) Section 6 is also amended to read as follows:
"Section 6. Reportorial Requirement. XXX
Within 30 days prior to its dissolution under Section 1 of
this Order, the Task Force shall publish a final report on its
accomplishments aligned with the key thematic areas of the
Boracay Action Plan, including plans and programs implemented
and the total budget utilized."

Unaffected provisions. Except for the foregoing amendments, all
other provisions of EO No. 53 shall remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. All orders, rules and regulations, issuances, or any part
thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Order, are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this
the year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty.
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
Office of the President
